question: Approve the shaped manual Cycle-Release admission path to enter implementation?

artifacts.summary: The Pilot shape uses existing GitHub, Spacedock, profile-loader, comparator, and worktree seams. It defines one fresh-context manual journey, six scanner-readable and falsifiable acceptance criteria, seven existing touch files, and stop conditions at more than 7 files, 175 changed lines, or 90 deterministic-test lines. Future Issues start directly with The problem; no new wrapper, runtime, schema, automatic dispatch, provider write, stage, or release authority is added.
